patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports experiencing fever, chills, and a headache starting three days after undergoing an open cholecystectomy. She has a history of an abdominal hysterectomy 16 years ago. She has been smoking one pack of cigarettes daily for 17 years.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Right-sided chest pain that increases on inspiration
Secondary_Symptoms: Productive cough for the last 12 hours

Social_History.Smoking_Status: Current smoker, one pack daily for 17 years

Review_of_Systems.Gastrointestinal: Surgical site below right ribcage, otherwise unremarkable

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate the patient presenting with postoperative fever, chest pain that increases on inspiration, and a productive cough, and determine the correct diagnosis.
